books.title: Shaking Medicine: The Healing Power of Ecstatic Movement
books.author: Bradford Keeney
books.description: Brad Keeney's book on shaking and ecstatic movement as a spiritual practice, published by Inner Traditions in 2007. It draws on the traditions he learned from, above all the Kalahari Bushmen's healing dance, and on how spontaneous movement can open a person to spirit.
